devices.name: Blokas Midiboy
devices.tagline: Arduino-compatible DIY handheld with an OLED screen and two DIN MIDI ports, running MIDI tools and games as sketches

devices.name: M-VAVE Tank-PRO
devices.tagline: Battery-powered guitar and bass multi-effects pedal with a colour screen, drum machine and looper

devices.name: Plinky Plinky12
devices.tagline: 12 by 12 inch touch synth with a 16 by 16 pad grid, programmed with C++ panels from a browser IDE

devices.name: Sonicake Amphonix 2
devices.tagline: Plug-in Bluetooth headphone guitar amp with 50 presets and NAM support (QAP-50)

entries.name: Syntakt Project
entries.summary: Browser and source builder for Syntakt OS 1.41 mods built from your own official file. The main mod, DelayCtrl, turns MOD B into a freeze and repeat, adds a DJ filter type and a drive rectifier, and a mod SDK lets other…

entries.name: TBBR - The Big Black Rig
entries.summary: Replacement firmware for the BlackBox with real-time NAM A2 Lite, cabinet impulse responses, modelled pedals and amps, a two-row block grid with scenes and 80 presets, plus a bilingual editor and a Windows installer tha…

entries.name: ABYSS
entries.summary: Experimental noise synth firmware for the FM-1 with up to four voices of three oscillators, six noise types, FM, ring mod and sync, six drive types, two feedback delays, two LFOs and MIDI clock sync.

entries.name: BabbleBeat
entries.summary: Experimental speech instrument: every key says a phrase built by a sentence grammar that can be mutated and made to remember a word, spoken by a small robotic formant voice.

entries.name: BARLINE
entries.summary: Five-track clip sketchpad for techno that sends its projects to Ableton Live: whole-bar clips in eight scenes, with each track's sound described by the parameters of a Live device.

entries.name: BE HERE NOW
entries.summary: Sarod-inspired string instrument with a tanpura drone and sympathetic strings, plus a browser Coach that teaches improvising in Western and Indian music alongside the FM-1.

entries.name: BEACHCOMBER
entries.summary: Random arpeggiator and four-track looper for the FM-1: a Turing-Machine-style loop of sixteen dice feeds four Karplus-Strong tracks, with 43 scales, delay, hall and chorus.

entries.name: BONBLOOP
entries.summary: SLOOP 2.8.5 plus a synth mode: hold ENV and the selected track becomes a three-oscillator wavetable synth with its own envelopes, LFOs, filter and a buildable effects chain.

entries.name: BOURDON
entries.summary: Drone instrument firmware for the FM-1 (called DR1 until V0.33) with three voices of six styles and free frequencies, links between the voices, shared noise, chop and ring disruptors, a bank of twelve LFOs, a mixer, del…

entries.name: CLOCKBOX
entries.summary: Port of the ClockBox v3 MIDI master clock to the FM-1: 24 PPQN clock over USB and Bluetooth MIDI, quantized restart, two follow modes, tap tempo, three tempo presets and a sync pulse on the audio output.

entries.name: COLLAPSE
entries.summary: Physics drum machine for the FM-1: six synthesized instruments hang in a web of springs so that every hit pushes the others, with eight patterns, a performance mode with live effects and MIDI clock sync.

entries.name: Doinua
entries.summary: Music companion for the FM-1 that teaches while you play: a four-track song of chords, bass, melody and drums with key detection and adjustable help, plus Producer, Guided and Game modes. Early; not yet run on a real FM…

entries.name: Endless Memory
entries.summary: Shepard-tone synth for the FM-1 with a staircase sequencer: each note is eight partials that seem to rise or fall for ever, and a short phrase climbs one scale step per repeat.

entries.name: FLAT-20
entries.summary: Circuit-level Korg MS-20 model for the FM-1 with solved KORG35 filters, patch-panel cables, 26 presets, MIDI and USB audio, and a macOS app that shows the front panel live.

entries.name: FM-GB
entries.summary: Game Boy (DMG) emulator firmware for the FM-1: you choose your own game ROM, it is packed into the firmware package in the browser, and the keys act as the d-pad and buttons.

entries.name: FM-1 CRAFT
entries.summary: Controller firmware that turns the FM-1 into a hardware panel for FigCraft, a Figma tool: keys send hotkeys, knobs send relative controllers, and the screen shows the selected layer and four values.

entries.name: FM-1 Felucca on Raspberry Pi
entries.summary: Terminal guide and scripts for flashing Felucca onto the FM-1 from a Raspberry Pi running Home Assistant, with a fix for the USB drop-outs the audio container causes and a small server that plays melodies on the FM-1 fr…

entries.name: fm1-hv
entries.summary: Virus-inspired synth for the FM-1 with two oscillators, two filters, two LFOs, unison, chorus and delay, reading Virus single patches. Version 0.0, early development; not yet run on a real FM-1.

entries.name: fm1-orchestra
entries.summary: Python tools for playing orchestral pieces on the FM-1 from a Mac over USB MIDI: DX7 patch loading, eight-part song modules, MusicXML score import, recording from the FM-1's USB audio and slide-show videos.

entries.name: Jigantic
entries.summary: Desktop interface for JIANT FM in the browser: clip timeline, piano roll, drum grid, mixer and generator that speak JIANT's own editor protocol over Web MIDI, with a built-in demo device.

entries.name: JUNIPER FM-1
entries.summary: Six-voice polysynth inspired by the Roland Juno-106, with a DCO, resonant four-pole filter, stereo chorus, six voice modes, arpeggiator, Juno-106 SysEx and 128 patches, installed from a browser page. Formerly JUNO FM-1.

entries.name: Melisma
entries.summary: Band-in-a-box for the FM-1: dials labelled with moods, energies and styles make a four-part band of bass, chords, melody and drums, and the keys offer only notes that fit.

entries.name: MUMBLE
entries.summary: Voice firmware for the FM-1 in which eight retro-game characters sing a typed line a syllable at a time from formant synthesis, with a choir on chords, an arpeggiator and a multitrack loop.

entries.name: OrganVave
entries.summary: Tonewheel organ with nine drawbars, percussion, scanner vibrato, a rotary speaker, drive, effects and a lower manual and pedals over MIDI, ported from setBfree to integer C for the FM-1.

entries.name: RDPNO
entries.summary: Roland MKS-20 and Rhodes MK-80 SA piano sounds on the FM-1, played by a cycle-exact emulation of their CPU-B board that reads ROM dumps you load yourself. Browser installer, ROM loader and live editor.

entries.name: RhinoTiger
entries.summary: Generative psytrance firmware for the FM-1, from dark psy to hi-tech, that plays itself on a sixteenth grid in eight worlds while four macro knobs, a mixer, one-shot keys and sixteen performance effects steer it.

entries.name: ROM-1
entries.summary: Sixteen-part multitimbral sound module that plays SoundFont (.sf2) files converted in the browser to fit the FM-1's flash, with a filter, envelopes, reverb and chorus.

entries.name: STRANGER SYNTH
entries.summary: Performance synth for the FM-1 in the style of 1980s analogue film scores, with detuned saws, macro knobs, a low split, arpeggiator, chords, sidechain, a heartbeat groove and eight tape-style effects.

entries.name: TRI-6 FM-1
entries.summary: Six-voice polysynth in the style of the Sequential Trigon-6: three oscillators per voice with sync and poly mod, a ladder filter, a mod matrix, two effects, unison with chord memory, an arpeggiator and 128 factory patch…

entries.name: TUNNEL FM-1
entries.summary: Detroit techno groovebox for the FM-1: eight synthesized tracks that loop at their own lengths, three decks that switch presets on the bar, delay, reverb, a DJ filter and 128 presets. First release, not yet tested on a…

entries.name: GHR AMBIENT
entries.summary: Replacement firmware for the Tank-G v2 that turns it into an ambient instrument with a granular cloud that freezes or follows the guitar, a long reverb, a dark smear echo and tape warble. Windows installer; backs up the…

entries.name: mvave-re
entries.summary: Reverse engineering notes and Python tools for the M-VAVE Tank-PRO and Tank-G: a firmware unpacker and repacker, a read-only USB-MIDI backup tool, and byte-level patches rebuilt from your own official .fwsc files.

entries.name: CardputerSynth
entries.summary: Cardputer-ADV firmware with a six-voice Juno-106-style polysynth and an eight-voice DX7-style FM engine, played from a MIDI keyboard through the Unit MIDI or from the Cardputer keys, plus a second build on the AMY engin…

entries.name: fm1-card
entries.summary: Cardputer-ADV app that acts as a USB-MIDI host for M-VAVE FM-1 and SMK-37 units: it picks firmware packages from the Firmware Zoo catalog or an SD card, flashes them, routes MIDI and sends a clock. Early bring-up.

entries.name: Smart Box CFW
entries.summary: Rights warning: unofficial firmware for the Smart Box built from Sonicake's V1.0.6 code, with STOMP and scene modes, extra delays, reverbs and EQ models, 10 + 10 IR and Tone Catch slots and MIDI maps. Binary only, with…

entries.name: Galax-z
entries.summary: Dot-matrix companion app for the OP-Z on Mac, iPad and iPhone that follows the unit over USB or Bluetooth and shows its tracks, effects, notes and load, with pages that play it, a sampler, backups and the installer hub…

entries.name: Galax-z OS
entries.summary: Patches for the OP-Z OS 1.2.45, built from the OS read off your own unit: boot animations, A/B bar colours, Tumbler, EUCLID and GROOVE pages, USB-host keyboards, a load meter, more live voices, and a piano and compresso…

entries.name: BrickRack
entries.summary: Open-source pocket modular synthesizer for the TrimUI Brick Pro on NextUI that patches 29 modules with cables, among them ports of Émilie Gillet's open Eurorack firmware such as Plaits, Braids, Rings, Clouds and Marbles…

entries.name: BRIXEQ
entries.summary: Free, closed-source five-track step sequencer and groovebox for the TrimUI Brick on NextUI, in which every step carries its own full instrument snapshot, with eight synth and drum engines, scenes, song mode and WAV reco…

entries.name: Dronage Terminal
entries.summary: Free, closed-source ambient drone synthesizer for the TrimUI Brick on NextUI with four macro oscillators, a modulation matrix, eight LFOs, a modulation sequencer, delay and shimmer reverb, Scala tuning and WAV recording.

entries.name: EUCLIDTRACK
entries.summary: Free, closed-source four-track euclidean synth workstation for the TrimUI Brick on NextUI, with a large set of synth, FM, physical-model, sample and drum engines, modulators, macros, per-track effects, a master looper a…

entries.name: GrainBrick
entries.summary: Free, closed-source granular instrument for Knulli handhelds that makes ambient textures from samples or live input, with a rhythm slicer, a physical-modelling resonator, wavetable oscillators and MIDI. Beta.

entries.name: Grampus
entries.summary: Free, closed-source ORCA-style grid sequencer for the TrimUI Brick on NextUI, paired with nine polyphonic synth engines, eight tracks, scenes, per-track LFOs and effects, and WAV recording.

entries.name: PolyBrik
entries.summary: Port of Polyend's open Tracker Community Edition firmware, built with the Tracker Mini feature set, to the TrimUI Brick and Brick Pro as a NextUI pak, with a button map, on-screen action list and Linux audio and display…
